name: The Origami Ocean Explorer
description: A massive paper ship made of folded origami sails across an ocean where the waves themselves are folded from blue and white paper, guided by paper birds with delicate wings.
prompt: A magnificent origami sailing ship with intricate folded paper sails navigating an ocean where the waves are made of blue and white folded paper, paper seagulls and origami birds flying alongside, detailed paper texture visible on the ship and waves, soft lighting with shadows creating depth, serene and magical atmosphere, highly detailed paper craft art style, fantasy naval adventure
caption: Charting courses through folded seas... ⛵📄 Where would your paper vessel sail?
